item.title: Firefighters make progress against a Nevada wildfire that’s destroyed more than 30 homes
item.description: Crews have started to contain a wildfire in the Sierra Nevada foothills that destroyed more than 30 homes as it spread perilously close to neighborhoods in Reno, Nevada.
